commit 381d024cba30748bb11256c8ebc0cd29755883c3
Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Jun 25 01:25:15 2026 +0000
Commit:     daniel@thunderbird.net <daniel@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Jun 25 01:27:19 2026 +0000

    Bug 1965145 - Port bug 1948315: Switch release-version-bump to scriptworker-lando. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D249728

diff --git a/taskcluster/config.yml b/taskcluster/config.yml
index 74302233ff6..61d7213744c 100644
--- a/taskcluster/config.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/config.yml
@@ -226,6 +226,14 @@ workers:
                 by-release-level:
                     production: comm-3-tree
                     staging: comm-1-tree
+        lando:
+            provisioner: scriptworker-k8s
+            implementation: scriptworker-lando
+            os: linux
+            worker-type:
+                by-release-level:
+                    production: '{trust-domain}-3-lando'
+                    staging: '{trust-domain}-1-lando'
         t-linux-docker(-noscratch)?(-amd)?:
             provisioner: comm-t
             implementation: docker-worker
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
index c57d1c778ac..34cc54b0c02 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@ loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 
 transforms:
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
-    - comm_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
 
 kind-dependencies:
@@ -17,31 +17,41 @@ task-defaults:
     description: Release Promotion version bump/tag
     run-on-projects: []
     shipping-phase: ship
-    worker-type: tree
+    worker-type: lando
     worker:
-        implementation: treescript
-        dontbuild: true
-        tags: ['release']
-        bump:
+        implementation: scriptworker-lando
+        lando-repo:
             by-project:
-                comm-esr.*: false
-                default: true
-        bump-files:
-            by-release-type:
-                default: ["mail/config/version_display.txt"]
-                release|esr.*:
-                    - "mail/config/version.txt"
-                    - "mail/config/version_display.txt"
-        push:
-            by-project:
-                comm-(beta|release|esr.*): true
-                default: false
+                comm-beta: thunderbird-beta
+                comm-release: thunderbird-release
+                comm-esr128: thunderbird-esr128
+                comm-esr140: thunderbird-esr140
+                try-comm-central: thunderbird-try
+                default: ""
+        actions:
+            - tag:
+                  types: ["release"]
+
+                  # Used to map hg revisions to the git revisions needed by scriptworker-lando
+                  hg-repo-url:
+                      by-project:
+                          comm-beta: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-beta
+                          comm-release: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-release
+                          comm-esr128: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-esr128
+                          comm-esr140: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-esr140
+                          try: https://hg.mozilla.org/try-comm-central
+                          default: ""
+            - version-bump:
+                  bump-files:
+                      by-release-type:
+                          default: ["mail/config/version_display.txt"]
+                          release|esr.*:
+                              - "mail/config/version.txt"
+                              - "mail/config/version_display.txt"
 
 tasks:
-    thunderbird-comm:
-        name: thunderbird-comm-version-bump
-        worker:
-            repo-param-prefix: comm_
+    thunderbird:
+        name: thunderbird-version-bump
         shipping-product: thunderbird
         treeherder:
             platform: thunderbird-release/opt
title: Bug 1965145 - Port bug 1948315: Switch release-version-bump to scriptworker-lando. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,coreycb
